subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the final rebased head be accepted as one grouped update for the secret-bearing, release, security-scanning, and agent-execution workflows?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but the protected security label and changed third-party executable code require an owner to accept the grouped supply-chain and operational blast radius.

options.title: Validate and approve group
options.body: Review the upstream changes and require representative sensitive-workflow checks on the final head before merging the grouped update.

options.title: Split sensitive action families
options.body: Separate Codex, app-token, CodeQL, and Docker publishing updates into focused PRs if representative validation cannot establish confidence in the grouped change.

recommendation.title: Validate and approve group
recommendation.body: Review the upstream changes and require representative sensitive-workflow checks on the final head before merging the grouped update.
